units.source_text: 千重子饲养的金钟儿，现在增加了很多，已经发展到两个古丹波壶了。

en.t: The bell crickets Chieko kept had multiplied greatly by now, enough to fill two old Tamba jars.

units.source_text: 每年照例从七月一日左右开始孵出幼虫，约莫在八月中旬就会鸣叫。

en.t: Every year, as usual, the larvae began hatching around July first, and by about mid-August they would start to sing.
